item.title: Martha M. Hale
item.description: Martha Mildred Hale, 97, Winamac, died Monday, Nov. 24, 2025, in Winamac. She was born March 24, 1928, in Barboursville, Ky. Her first husband, Dan Miracle, and second husband, James Hale, both preceded her in death. item.title: County fire association hears about fire territories, districts

item.title: Festival of Trees In Fort Wayne Opens for 41st Season
item.description: The 41st annual Festival of Trees opens at 3 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 26, and runs through 1 p.m. Wednesday, Dec. 3.

item.title: Three Indiana Counties Pass Data Center Moratoriums
item.description: White County on Monday, Oct. 20 became the latest Indiana community to halt data center development, approving a moratorium after months of public opposition and uncertainty surrounding a proposed project near Wolcott.

item.title: Initial Hearing Held For Warsaw Man Charged With OWI Resulting In Brother’s Death
item.description: An initial hearing was recently held for a Warsaw man who allegedly drove under the influence, resulting in the death of his brother.

item.title: Eli Lilly Becomes First Pharmaceutical To Hit $1 Trillion Valuation
item.description: Eli Lilly and Co. on Friday, Nov. 21 became the first health care company to surpass a $1 trillion market valuation, driven by intense investor demand for its fast-growing weight-loss drug portfolio.
